name: toolbar-expandable
title: Toolbar Expandable
description: A compact horizontal toolbar of numbered tabs with a small badge above it. Choosing a tab grows a card above the bar holding that section's title, description and content; choosing it again or clicking away folds it shut.
use: A dense app header needs several sections as tabs, each with a short panel of details in place.
avoid: The panel content is long: the inline card grows with it instead of scrolling.
a11y: The bar is a row of plain buttons with no tablist roles or focus ring, so keyboard users get little feedback. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small outlined Navigation badge sits above a rounded horizontal toolbar of four tabs. Each tab pairs a little numbered square with a label, and the active tab is tinted. An open tab shows a soft card above the bar with a title, grey description and body text.
behaves: Clicking a tab opens the card above the bar with that step's copy; clicking the same tab again or anywhere outside closes it. The card animates its height with a short spring, and the tab row scrolls sideways when the tabs overflow.
customise: Pass a steps array with title, description, icon and content, plus a badgeText and controlled expanded or activeStep state. Styling is class-based.
weight: light: A few buttons and one animated height panel; no canvas or heavy lists.
demo: Tabs Profile, Dashboard, Notifications and Settings; the Dashboard card lists 12,430 visits and 340 active users.
issues: The active step's title shows twice, once above the card and again inside it.
Tabs have no focus-visible ring, so keyboard focus is hard to see.
polishWhy: Tidy toolbar and smooth height change; the duplicated title and missing focus ring look rough.
